newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close lower after seesaw on IMF.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close lower after seesaw on IMF.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed lower on Monday after a seesaw on International Monetary Fund (IMF) news, and dealers said scrips were likely to fall on Tuesday's settlement day owing to profit-taking.
The stocks opened sharply up on the hope of a good economic package this week, but slipped before the close owing to a halt to an IMF standby loan to Pakistan last week, a dealer said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 16.00 points, or 1.00 percent, lower at 1,576.75 after rising to 1,605.96 in early trade. Losers led gainers 157 to 124. Fauji Fertiliser fell 4.0 rupees to 80. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
